## Recommended Layering

**For npm projects:**
1. npm audit (baseline, free) [24]
2. Dependabot (automated PRs, free) [75]
3. Socket.dev CLI (behavioral analysis, free tier) [38]
4. npm provenance verification (`npm audit signatures`) [65]

**For Python projects:**
1. pip-audit (baseline, free) [31]
2. Dependabot (automated PRs, free) [75]
3. Socket.dev CLI (behavioral analysis, free tier) [38]
4. PEP 740 attestation awareness (verification tooling maturing) [73]

**For teams with budget:**
Add Snyk [42] or Socket.dev paid tier [41] for priority scoring,
reachability analysis, and faster vulnerability database updates.

All citations reference [dependency-tools-citations.md](../dependency-tools-citations.md).
